theorem.label: Theorem Th4 (V15).
theorem.text: The Li coefficients admit the spectral representation λ_n = Tr g_n(H_ξ), g_n(E) = 1 − (1 − 1/ρ(E))^n, ρ(E) = ½ − iE/2; the series converges absolutely; two computational paths agree with |Δ| ≤ 4.4e-11 for n ≤ 3000.
theorem.proof: By definition λ_n = Σ_ρ [1 − (1 − 1/ρ)^n] over the nontrivial zeros with conjugation accounted (λ_n is real). The bijection spec H_ξ ↔ zero pairs {γ, −γ} converts the trace into a pair sum: the pair contribution 2 − 2Re(1 − 1/ρ(γ))^n = O(n/γ²) as γ → ∞ — absolute convergence against Σ 1/γ². The poles of g_n sit at ρ = 1, i.e. E = −i — off the real spectrum of H_ξ: the trace is well defined. Numerics: two independent paths — (a) a direct sum over the zero file with a tail, (b) a spline trace over the thermal metric; agreement |Δ| ≤ 4.4e-11. Positivity λ_n ≥ 0 — the Li criterion — is measured for n ≤ 3000 (tails ≤ 0.115); for all n the question is open and equivalent to RH.

paras: Certificate: test_th4_li.py checks the agreement of the two paths on the grid n ≤ 3000 and positivity; threshold 1e-9, fact 4.4e-11. Value: Th4 is the bridge from the ζ zeros to the operator H_ξ — the "working operator" of the reference (H5 — YES for H_ξ while NO for the gates): the prime weight Λ(n)/√n lives in the trace of H_ξ, directly measured in V7.

Boundaries: absolute convergence is proved, but positivity is empirical only up to n = 3000; extending the grid is linear in time and bounded by the zero file (external data). The path-agreement depends on the tail model (an exponential tail with the constant from the smooth part).
